description: Synthesizes a 6-line /llms.txt documentation index preview and a Google Lighthouse 13.5 /.well-known/ai-catalog.json (ARD 1.0) JSON preview from a live remote domain, returning both code blocks in Markdown alongside remediation links. Use this tool when a user wants to preview the discovery manifests needed to fix gaps found by audit_ai_readiness on a live domain; do not use it for full-page content extraction (use extract_byte0_markdown instead) or local filesystem inspection (use audit_local_codebase instead). If a full URL path is passed in domain, the generator automatically normalizes it to the registrable origin root before synthesizing root-level /llms.txt and /.well-known/ai-catalog.json URIs. Read-only synthesis that never modifies remote servers or local files; requires no API key, has a 60 req/min rate limit, and falls back to baseline origin metadata if the target blocks crawlers.

domain.description: Target domain name or root URL to generate manifest previews for (e.g., "example.com" or "https://example.com"). Path segments are stripped to the origin root.

name: generate_ai_manifests
title: Generate /llms.txt & Lighthouse 13.5 ai-catalog.json Previews
